sentences.text:
======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ANJANI KUMAR SHARAN  ORAL ORDER 2 18-07-2023 Heard the parties.
2. The petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offence punishable under Sections 341, 323, 498A, 307, 376, 504, 506 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. Petitioner, who is the father-in-law of the informant is said to have forcefully established illicit relation with the informant.
It is also alleged that on objection, the informant was assaulted by all the accused persons.
4. It is submitted by learned senior counsel for the petitioner that petitioner is quite innocent and have committed no offence.
He has been falsely implicated in this case.
No such occurrence, in the manner as alleged, has ever taken place.
The allegation levelled against the petitioner is not specific rather Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.36273 of 2023(2) dt.18-07-2023 general and omnibus in nature.
Petitioner is the father-in-law of the informant and there is no specific overt act against him.

He further submits that the husband of the informant and the co- accused Shashi Singh has been Balram Singh @ Baliram Singh vs The State Of Bihar on 18 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/34002746/
1 granted regular bail by a co- ordinate Bench of this Court.
